rationale.edition: Every changed path in changed_files.txt lives under web/src/**, web/src/utils, or tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/. None are under enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/). No enterprise keywords (cipher, SSO, SAML, RBAC, SDR, sensitive-data) appear in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The diff alters user-facing frontend code in web/src (logs Index.vue stream-type watcher guard, IndexList.vue stream tooltip/truncate, OEmptyState.vue layout, streamPersist.ts localStorage handling). No skip label or comment is present (feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are empty).

rationale.group: Logs-Core. The spec exercises core Logs page stream-type/stream-selector persistence, matching sibling Logs specs (logspage.spec.js, logstable.spec.js, logsquickmode.spec.js) that belong to the Logs-Core shard, whose actual_folder is Logs.
